relationships.subject: TrkB
relationships.evidence_quote: The results confirmed that TrkB is expressed presynaptically and plays a role in the development of dynamic and punctate mechanical allodynia during BDNF-induced spinal plasticity responses, but has no effect on thermal or cold allodynia.

relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: In the spinal cord, brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) exerts its regulatory role on neuropathic pain through its receptor TrkB.

key_findings: Sensory neuron/nociceptor-specific TrkB deletion left baseline sensation intact but, after CCI, impaired dynamic and punctate mechanical allodynia while thermal and cold allodynia developed normally.
TrkB is expressed in sensory neurons and nociceptors in DRG, supporting presynaptic BDNF-TrkB signaling.
